title: The launch of the Nymo, what a milestone!
excerpt: The Nymo was launched in October, with which you can turn a boiler into a Water Battery. Solyx Energy takes you into this milestone!
contentHtml:
How beautiful it would be if you use more of your solar energy, and at the same time use less gas for heating water. But how do you do that? The Nymo was launched in October, with which you can turn a boiler into a Water Battery. We are happy to tell you how we experienced this milestone!

Reason and development of the Nymo

Two years ago, Solyx Energy introduced the Solar iBoost in the Netherlands, a predecessor of the Nymo with similar functionalities. The reactions were very positive, but in three quarters of the cases we had to sell a no, because the Solar iBoost only worked at single-phase house connections. However, many households have a three-phase home connection or inverter.  

With our new product, that problem is a thing of the past: the Nymo is suitable for both single phase and three phase connections. After a year and a half of development and testing, we proudly launched our new product in October 2024: the Nymo!

Launch at the Energy Trade Fair

A highlight of the launch was our participation in the Energy Trade Fair in the Brabanthallen. This annual fair is the platform for sustainable innovations and energy solutions, and we are proud that the Nymo was central here.

Our stand attracted many visitors, including consumers, installers and business partners. Live demonstrations by the Nymo showed how simple and effective our system works. The feedback we received was overwhelmingly positive and gave us new insights for future developments. It was inspiring to see how the Nymo not only aroused interest, but also started conversations about the future of energy management in households.

A selection of our media launch

We are very proud that the Nymo received plenty of media attention and was praised on several leading platforms:

  • The Groene Nerds Podcast called the Nymo a user-friendly solution that perfectly matches the current need for smart energy savings. Emma was a guest at De Groene Nerds in De Podcasters’ studio.
  • BNR Nieuwsradio praised the product as an example of innovative technology that makes sustainable life more accessible. Listen to the broadcast to hear more about the product, its development, and how Solyx Energy wants to grow.
  • Gawalo, the specialist magazine for installers, emphasized how the simplicity of the Nymo makes work easier for professionals.
  • Duurzaam-Ondernemen.nl praised the Nymo as a sustainable breakthrough that helps households maximize solar energy.
  • MT / Sprout described the Nymo as a must-have for energy-conscious consumers and an opportunity for entrepreneurs to respond to the growing demand for sustainability.

The launch of the Nymo marks an important step in our mission to help households make better use of solar energy with qualitative and affordable solutions. At Solyx Energy we are very proud of the steps we have taken and we look to the future with enthusiasm!

The Solar iBoost will remain available for the time being, but we are shifting our focus to the Nymo, which can be used in a much wider range.
